answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 49928 Country: India Title: Names Question: In-shaAllah, we are expecting our first baby in few days. Please let us know few names of baby boy and baby girl in the names of the Prophets and Sahabiyats. Also what is the meaning of the Arabic name Luhaidan and Jaza? Answer ID: 49928 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 125/125/M=02/1435) These are the names for baby boy: Huzaifa, Ammar, Affan, Hassan, Zakwan, Saad, Salman etc. And for baby girl: Fatimah, Ayishah, Bareerah, Sadiyah, Aatikah, Zainab, Ruqayyah, Sumayyah, Yumna, Maimunah etc. Please, write the correct Arabic spelling of the name you asked. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
